events.title: Deno runtime: development ends after one more year (team joined Cloudflare)
events.summary: The Deno team joined Cloudflare. Deno gets monthly bug-fix and security releases for one more year, then Deno Land ends development of the runtime. It stays open source.

replacements.name: Node.js
replacements.note: most Deno code with npm: specifiers ports with small changes

replacements.name: Cloudflare Workers / workerd
replacements.note: where the Deno team is putting future work

events.title: Deno Deploy shuts down six months after the Cloudflare deal
events.summary: Deno Deploy keeps operating for six months from Oct 9 2026, then shuts down. Paying customers get migration support to Cloudflare Workers. deployctl is already archived.

replacements.name: Cloudflare Workers
replacements.note: official migration path for paying customers

replacements.name: Vercel, Netlify, Fly.io, Render
replacements.note: other hosts that run JS/TS servers

events.title: Val Town is winding down
events.summary: No new signups since Nov 10 2026. Read-only mode (except SQLite and blob storage) on Dec 10 2026, all other services end Jan 10 2027, code to be open-sourced Feb 1 2027.

replacements.name: Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, Render
replacements.note: Val Town publishes a migration guide for each

events.title: Bitnami free images and charts removed from Docker Hub
events.summary: Broadcom moved the free docker.io/bitnami catalog to docker.io/bitnamilegacy (frozen, no updates) and now ships only a small set of hardened 'latest' images for free. Versioned tags and the bitnamicharts OCI charts that depend on them stop getting updates or vanish.

replacements.name: the upstream project's official image/chart
replacements.note: e.g. postgres, redis/valkey, the CloudNativePG operator

replacements.name: docker.io/bitnamilegacy/*
replacements.note: stopgap only: frozen, no security updates

events.title: LocalStack community repo archived; running it now needs an account
events.summary: localstack/localstack was archived and consolidated into a single image that needs a LocalStack account (free Hobby plan is non-commercial only). CI that pulls localstack/localstack without an auth token is at risk.

replacements.name: aws/aws-emulator
replacements.note: AWS's own local emulator of the AWS APIs (github.com/aws/aws-emulator)

replacements.name: moto (server mode)
replacements.note: Python AWS mock, also runs as a standalone server

events.title: Kubernetes ingress-nginx is retired
events.summary: Best-effort maintenance ended in March 2026. No more releases, bug fixes or security fixes. Existing images and charts stay available, so nothing breaks until the next CVE.

replacements.name: another maintained Ingress controller
replacements.note: if you must stay on the Ingress API

events.title: MinIO community edition is no longer maintained
events.summary: github.com/minio/minio is archived and its README says the repository is no longer maintained, pointing to the AIStor Free/Enterprise editions instead.

events.title: k8s.gcr.io is frozen
events.summary: The old Kubernetes image registry k8s.gcr.io stopped getting new images in April 2023 and is being shut down. Use registry.k8s.io.

events.title: Terraform relicensed to BUSL-1.1 (not open source)
events.summary: HashiCorp moved Terraform from MPL-2.0 to the Business Source License, which restricts competing commercial use. OpenTofu is the Linux Foundation fork of the last MPL version.

events.title: Vault relicensed to BUSL-1.1 (not open source)
events.summary: HashiCorp moved Vault from MPL-2.0 to the Business Source License. OpenBao is the Linux Foundation fork.

events.title: Redis relicensed (RSALv2/SSPL, AGPLv3 added in Redis 8)
events.summary: Redis left the BSD license in 2024 (RSALv2/SSPLv1). Redis 8 added AGPLv3 as a third option. Valkey is the Linux Foundation fork of the last BSD version.

events.title: Create React App is deprecated
events.summary: The React team deprecated Create React App for new apps and put it in maintenance mode. The repo moved to react/create-react-app.

replacements.name: Vite
replacements.note: closest drop-in for a client-side SPA

events.title: actions-rs/* GitHub Actions are archived
events.summary: The actions-rs organisation's actions are archived and still run on deprecated Node runtimes and set-output.

events.title: actions/create-release and actions/upload-release-asset are archived
events.summary: GitHub archived both actions in 2021; they are unmaintained.

replacements.name: gh release create
replacements.note: the GitHub CLI is preinstalled on hosted runners

events.title: node-sass / LibSass are deprecated
events.summary: LibSass and node-sass are deprecated and the repo is archived. Native builds break on new Node versions.

replacements.name: sass (Dart Sass)
replacements.note: npm i -D sass; same API for most builds

events.title: request is deprecated
events.summary: The request HTTP client was deprecated in 2020 and gets no fixes.

events.title: TSLint is deprecated
events.summary: TSLint was deprecated in favour of typescript-eslint and the repo is archived.

events.title: Moment.js is in maintenance mode
events.summary: Moment's maintainers consider it a legacy project in maintenance mode and recommend other libraries for new code.

replacements.name: Luxon, date-fns, Day.js
replacements.note: or the Temporal API where available
